one_line: Bengali chemist, industrial nationalist and historian of Hindu chemistry who built modern science and pharmaceuticals in colonial India.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to early 50s, medium height, slightly stooped academic build.
appearance.face: Oval face with high forehead, wheatish-light brown complexion, neatly trimmed short moustache, thin round spectacles, gentle intelligent eyes, default expression calm, thoughtful with a faint determined smile.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed back dark greying hair with a clear side part; no headwear, hair kept modest and professional.
appearance.costume: Early 20th-century Bengali bhadralok attire: long white cotton panjabi/kurta with a straight collar reaching mid-thigh, over ankle-length white dhoti with careful pleats and a border; a dark charcoal-grey woolen shawl draped over both shoulders like a blazer substitute, and simple brown leather lace-up shoes; textiles plain, fine cotton and wool, no ornate patterns.
appearance.signature: A worn brown leather-bound notebook held in the left hand with a lightweight brass fountain pen tucked between its pages, evoking his laboratory records and historical notes rather than political or military action.

ref_desc: Prafulla Chandra Ray is a late-middle-aged Bengali chemist with oval spectacled face, short greying parted hair, white kurta and dhoti, charcoal-grey shawl, brown leather shoes, and a brown notebook with brass pen, in a white-grey-brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Prafulla Chandra Ray: a late-middle-aged Bengali chemist with an oval face, wheatish-light brown skin, high forehead, short greying hair neatly parted and combed back, thin round spectacles, and a small trimmed moustache, his default expression calm and thoughtful with a faint determined smile. He wears an early 20th-century white cotton panjabi-style kurta reaching mid-thigh over an ankle-length white dhoti with clear pleats and a subtle border, a dark charcoal-grey woolen shawl draped evenly over both shoulders like a dignified substitute for a coat, and plain brown leather lace-up shoes. In his left hand he holds a worn brown leather-bound notebook with a lightweight brass fountain pen tucked between its pages as his single signature prop, suggesting laboratory notes and historical research. Use a palette dominated by white for the garments, charcoal grey for the shawl, brown for shoes and notebook, dark grey for pen details, and a warm wheatish tone for his skin, showing him from multiple angles to clearly capture his consistent hair, face, costume, and notebook-pen combination.
